finding_key: packages/cli/test/login-callback.test.ts::nonce-mismatch coverage only exercises the length-differs branch, so a length-only comparison would pass
evidence: Verified against the supplied files at this commit. nonceMatches (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts, the constant-time compare helper) is `a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b)`; the test's rejection cases in packages/cli/test/login-callback.test.ts are a missing state (caught by the `!received` guard) and `state=guessed` (7 chars vs the 9-char 'the-nonce'), which short-circuits on the length check. A mutant returning only `a.length === b.length` passes all assertions including the accept case, so the value-comparison branch is genuinely unpinned; a same-length wrong-value case is absent. Real test-adequacy gap, though production behavior itself is correct, hence minor.
